description.value:
Area 20-foot emanation

Duration until the encounter ends

Claim the ground. While you remain within 5 feet of where you declared this, enemies in the area must spend an additional action to Stride, cannot Step, and are off-guard against your Strikes. You may make one ranged Strike as a reaction against each enemy that enters the area, once per enemy per round, without expending your reaction and without spending ammunition.
